audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill on all seven stages while the prose hands Cassiopeia five of them, and the level-6 line promises a clean stun on Galio's engage.
audit.why: Petrifying Gaze 'stun[s] any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slow[s] any others with their back turned' — a Galio who turns away during Justice Punch or Hero's Entrance eats a slow, not a stun. The mirror audit (audits/top/galio__cassiopeia.json) already tells the Galio player to turn his back, so an unconditional stun on this page contradicts it.
audit.corrected: Chart left as Skill on both sides to match the mirror; the level-6 and mid text now state the facing condition and tell you to fire R into his commit rather than at a turned back.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown number appears anywhere in either layer, so every spike line is vague about when the window actually opens.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s, Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14s, Hero's Entrance 180/160/140s, Miasma 24s at rank 1 and Noxious Blast a flat 3.5s. Those numbers are what make 'bait it, then go' actionable.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the cooldown block, the early text, the trigger lines and the wants list.

audit.whatIsWrong: content early and wants.you[0] claim Miasma's grounding shuts off both Justice Punch and Hero's Entrance. The decisive half — that grounded means the dash does not cast at all — is stated loosely, and the R claim is unsupported.
audit.why: Riot's Miasma text says 'Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities', which covers the Justice Punch dash. Whether Hero's Entrance counts as a Movement ability for grounding is not in any local file and I could not verify it, so I removed the claim rather than repeat it.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated precisely against Justice Punch only; the Hero's Entrance grounding claim dropped and logged as unverified.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze answers his all-in: when he flies in with Hero's Entrance (R) or dashes E (Justice Punch) into W-taunt, your R stuns him out of the channel and your poison-fed E shreds the cancelled engage.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze answers his all-in, but only if he faces you — a Galio who turns his back takes the slow, not the stun. Fire it as Justice Punch lands, then poison-fed Twin Fang shreds the dead engage.

edits.before: Save W (Miasma) to ground his E dash (Justice Punch) and his R flight so he cannot gap-close or all-in you, then chain E off the poison
edits.after: Save W (Miasma) for his Justice Punch — grounded, the dash will not cast at all, and its 24s at rank 1 is your entire engage-denial budget

edits.before: Galio is a slow, melee-range AP tank with no early sustain, and you out-poke him from the first level — your Q lays poison, then E (Twin Fang) nukes for bonus damage and refunds most of its cooldown, so you can chain it on him while his Winds of War (Q) and passive-empowered auto do far less. Level 1 is roughly even since you only have one ability up and his point-and-click passive auto trades fine, but the moment you have two points across Q/E you prime-and-Twin-Fang for a real lead. Hold W (Miasma) — its grounding shuts off his E dash (Justice Punch) and his R, so save it to deny his gap-closer rather than burning it as a slow.
edits.after: Galio is a slow, melee-range AP tank with no early sustain, and you out-poke him from the first level — your Q lays poison, then E (Twin Fang) nukes for bonus damage on a 0.75s cooldown and heals you off it, so you chain it while his Winds of War (Q, 11s at rank 1) and passive auto do far less. Level 1 is roughly even since you only have one ability up and his point-and-click passive auto trades fine, but the moment you have two points across Q/E you prime-and-Twin-Fang for a real lead. Hold W (Miasma) for his Justice Punch — grounded, the dash will not cast at all — and count its own 24s, because that gap is the window he waits for.

edits.before: This is your lane to take over. Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fangs that melt a low-resist Galio, and his W-taunt (Shield of Durand) is the core of his all-in — bait it out or ground his E dash with Miasma before he can reach you, and his engage is dead. At 6 your Petrifying Gaze flips his dive into a kill: if he flies in with Hero's Entrance or E-dashes at you, R stuns him out of the channel and your poison-fed E finishes. Your leveled passive move speed and Q speed buff mean he cannot pin you, so poke him off the wave and force every trade before he buys magic resist.
edits.after: This is your lane to take over. Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fangs that melt a low-resist Galio, and his W-taunt (Shield of Durand, 18s) is the core of his all-in — bait it out or ground his Justice Punch with Miasma before he reaches you, and his engage is dead. At 6 Petrifying Gaze punishes the dive, but only if he faces you: a Galio who turns his back takes a slow, so fire it into his commit, not after it. Your leveled passive move speed and Q speed buff mean he cannot pin you, so poke him off the wave and force every trade before he buys magic resist.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze stuns him out of his Hero's Entrance / E-dash all-in — your clean answer to his only engage window, turning his dive into your kill.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze punishes his Justice Punch dive — but it only stuns a Galio who is facing you, so fire it into his commit and never at a back already turned.

edits.before: His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Noxious Blast is a 3.5s cooldown — every last-hit he takes should cost him poison.

edits.before: That’s Galio’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze online — the face-check stun flips every all-in: they engage, you R, they die in the E-spam.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze online — it flips his dive, but only stuns if he faces you; a turned back takes just the slow.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Miasma like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch: 11s at rank 1 — matchup-defining, and Miasma grounds it so the dash will not cast. - Shield of Durand: 18s. - Hero's Entrance: 180s. - Your Miasma: 24s, a fifth summoner spell.

notes: Twin Fang carries a derived 'projectile — can be blocked by Wind Wall-class effects' flag in the kit file, but Riot's own description reads as a targeted attack on a poisoned enemy. Per the trust-the-description rule I wrote nothing that depends on Twin Fang being a blockable projectile. Unverified and left out: whether Miasma's grounding stops Hero's Entrance.
